name: local-context
description: Per-feature working memory in .local_context/<feature>/ — CURRENT.md, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, ARCHIVE.md, optional BUSINESS.md and CODE_REVIEW_MAPPING.md. `local-context-new` creates it, `local-context-continue` resumes it, `local-context-start` does both, `local-context-tidy` cleans it, `local-context-business-questions` lists the decisions the business owes, `local-context-code-review-mapping` maps the changed files for review, `local-context-code-review-mapping-navigator` (alias `local-context-crn`) walks the map group by group in your IDE.
